author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Custom Connector
description: Creates a flat Power Platform custom connector project: apiDefinition.swagger.json + apiProperties.json (ProjectType=Connector). Reference it from a Solution project to package it as a Connector solution component.

TransformScript.description: Include a starter script.csx custom-code file for transforming requests/responses beyond what the OpenAPI definition alone can do (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/custom-connectors/write-code). The build picks it up automatically once it exists - no other setting needed.

DisplayName.description: Display name for the connector - shown to makers browsing/creating connections in Power Platform. There's no good default for user-facing text like this, so it's required rather than falling back to the project's logical name.

Description.description: Description of what the connector does - shown to makers alongside the display name in Power Platform.

Host.description: Hostname of the API this connector calls (the OpenAPI 'host' field), e.g. world.openfoodfacts.org.
